[SWS_DM_01078] Clear DDIDs on session change
⌈
If DiagnosticDy-
namicallyDefineDataIdentifierClass.checkPerSourceId is set to true and
a diagnostic session change occurs, the DM shall clear all defined DDIDs that have
sourceDataIdentifiers that are no longer supported in the new session and security
level.
⌋
